exceptions.reasoningEffort: A task-specific lower effort is allowed only when an explicit task contract records it; it does not change the default.
exceptions.serviceTier: Provider-selected normal/default routing is allowed. Callers must not request Fast, priority, or another paid tier override.

truthBoundary: This source policy names the approved account class but contains no credential and cannot independently attest which account is provisioned on a host. Deployment must preserve the existing approved PMHNP OAuth profile and verify it without recording secret values.
